name: Gmail Assistant — Busy Calendars

parameters.content:
## Busy calendars (shared)
Returns every event of the calendars listed in **Inbox Pilot Settings → busyCalendars** (edited in the app), plus any extra calendar ids passed in, from now to now + days.

Each event is tagged with `__calendarName`; a calendar that cannot be read returns `__calendarError` so callers refuse to propose times instead of double-booking. Used by Drafting, Events and Decisions.

description: Sub-workflow: returns events of all busy calendars (from Inbox Pilot Settings) plus extra calendar ids, tagged with calendar name; flags unreadable calendars.
